B.w: Admit for observation and IV treatment. Explain to the parents why leaving is unsafe.
u: Refuses feeds, very sleepy or floppy
Fast breathing, seizure or blue colour

C.w: Admit for monitoring with orthopaedic and vascular review. If cleared, wound check in 48 hours.
m: Leg pulses, colour, sensation and swelling
u: Severe or rising leg pain, tense swelling
Dark urine or very little urine

G.w: Blood pressure review with his own doctor within a week. Return if the nosebleed recurs.
m: Blood pressure after the bleed settles
Nosebleed recurrence; pause steroid nasal spray for about a week
u: Bleeding that does not stop after two tries of 10 minutes of firm pressure
Headache, vision change, weakness or confusion

H.w: No routine review if checks are normal. Report the reaction to the blood bank; no riding or driving today.
